scenarios.prompt: I'm prepping a board slide on why our ROE dropped this year. Break down ROE into its drivers for me. Net income $145M, revenue $2,200M, total assets $1,850M, total equity $720M. Report roe, net_margin, asset_turnover, equity_multiplier as decimals.

For the same firm, I want a deeper ROE breakdown that separates operating profitability from the tax and interest drag. Additional data: EBT (earnings before tax) = $195M, EBIT (earnings before interest and tax) = $240M. (Same balance sheet: net income $145M, revenue $2,200M, total assets $1,850M, total equity $720M.) Report roe, tax_burden, interest_burden, ebit_margin, asset_turnover, equity_multiplier as decimals.
